:LABEL: Formula;Definition
name: definition
informal: A smooth n-dimensional manifold M is a second-countable Hausdorff topological space equipped with a maximal smooth atlas of charts.

:LABEL: Formula;Definition
name: definition
informal: The tangent space T_p M at a point p in M is the vector space of all tangent vectors (derivations) at p.

:LABEL: Formula;Definition
name: definition
informal: A Riemannian metric g on M is a smooth assignment of a positive-definite inner product g_p on each tangent space T_p M.

:LABEL: Formula;Definition
name: definition
informal: The Levi-Civita connection \nabla is the unique torsion-free, metric-compatible affine connection on the Riemannian manifold (M,g).

:LABEL: Formula;Lemma
name: lemma
informal: Given any open cover of M, there exists a smooth partition of unity subordinate to it.
proof: Construct local bump functions from the smooth atlas of M and normalize by the locally finite sum.

:LABEL: Formula;Lemma
name: lemma
informal: The covariant derivative \nabla_X Y is tensorial (linear over C^\infty(M)) in X and satisfies the Leibniz rule in Y.
proof: Follows directly from the defining properties of the Levi-Civita connection.

:LABEL: Formula;Theorem
name: theorem
informal: The Riemann curvature tensor R measures the failure of iterated second covariant derivatives to commute; it is a (1,3)-tensor.
proof: Define R via the commutator of covariant derivatives and verify multilinearity and tensoriality in all four arguments.

:LABEL: Formula;Theorem
name: theorem
informal: For a closed orientable surface M, the integral of Gaussian curvature K over M equals 2\pi times its Euler characteristic \chi(M).
proof: Triangulate M, apply the local angle-defect formula, and sum defects using a partition of unity subordinate to the triangulation.

:LABEL: Symbol
name: T_p M
meaning: Tangent space at point p in M

:LABEL: Symbol
name: \chi(M)
meaning: Euler characteristic of the manifold M
